function.name: get_latest_news_headlines
function.description: Retrieves the most recent news headlines from various categories. Allows filtering by specific news categories or the number of headlines to return.

category.description: Optional. Filter headlines by a specific category (e.g., 'technology', 'sports', 'politics').

limit.description: Optional. The maximum number of headlines to retrieve, up to 100. Defaults to 10.

language.description: Optional. The language of the headlines (e.g., 'en' for English, 'es' for Spanish). Defaults to 'en'.

function.name: search_news_articles
function.description: Searches for news articles based on keywords, date range, and source. This tool is useful for finding specific articles or historical news.

query.description: Required. The keywords or phrase to search for in article titles and content.

from_date.description: Optional. Start date for the search range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

to_date.description: Optional. End date for the search range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

source.description: Optional. Filter results by a specific news source (e.g., 'BBC News', 'The New York Times').

page_size.description: Optional. The number of results per page, up to 50. Defaults to 20.

function.name: get_article_details
function.description: Retrieves the full content and metadata for a specific news article using its unique ID. This is useful for deep diving into a particular story.

article_id.description: Required. The unique identifier of the news article.

function.name: get_trending_topics
function.description: Fetches a list of the current trending news topics or keywords globally or within a specific country. This helps identify what's popular right now.

country.description: Optional. The two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code to get trending topics for (e.g., 'us', 'gb', 'in'). Defaults to global trends if not specified.

limit.description: Optional. The maximum number of trending topics to return, up to 20. Defaults to 10.

function.name: subscribe_to_newsletter
function.description: Subscribes a user to a daily or weekly news digest newsletter for a specified category. Users will receive updates directly to their email.

email.description: Required. The user's email address for the subscription.

category.description: Required. The news category to subscribe to (e.g., 'business', 'technology', 'world').

frequency.description: Optional. The desired frequency of the newsletter ('daily', 'weekly'). Defaults to 'daily'.

send_welcome_email.description: Optional. Whether to send an immediate welcome email. Defaults to true.

function.name: get_news_source_status
function.description: Checks the operational status of a specific news source or all registered news sources. Useful for identifying issues or available sources.

source_name.description: Optional. The name of a specific news source to check (e.g., 'CNN', 'Reuters'). If not provided, returns status for all sources.

function.name: get_website_traffic_data
function.description: Retrieves website traffic data for a specified period and optionally filtered by country or device type. This tool can provide insights into user engagement and geographical reach.

start_date.description: The start date for the traffic data, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: The end date for the traffic data, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

country.description: Optional: Filter traffic data by country (e.g., 'USA', 'Germany').

device_type.description: Optional: Filter traffic data by device type (e.g., 'desktop', 'mobile', 'tablet').

function.name: create_custom_report
function.description: Creates a new custom analytics report with specified metrics and dimensions. This allows users to define and save frequently used report configurations.

report_name.description: The name for the new custom report.

metrics.description: Comma-separated list of metrics to include (e.g., 'pageviews,users,sessions').

dimensions.description: Comma-separated list of dimensions to include (e.g., 'date,source,country').

is_public.description: Whether the report should be publicly accessible or private.

schedule_email_delivery.description: Whether to schedule email delivery of this report.

function.name: get_event_tracking_status
function.description: Checks the current status of a specific event tracking configuration. This can help verify if events are being collected correctly.

event_name.description: The name of the event to check (e.g., 'button_click', 'form_submission').

function.name: update_dashboard_widget
function.description: Updates an existing widget on a specified analytics dashboard with new configuration settings. This allows for dynamic adjustments to dashboard visualizations.

dashboard_id.description: The ID of the dashboard containing the widget.

widget_id.description: The ID of the widget to update.

new_title.description: Optional: A new title for the widget.

metric_to_display.description: Optional: The new primary metric to display (e.g., 'sessions', 'conversions').

time_period_days.description: Optional: The number of past days the widget should display data for.

function.name: export_data_to_csv
function.description: Exports a specific dataset, such as user segmentation or campaign performance, to a CSV file for external analysis. This is useful for offline processing or integration with other tools.

dataset_name.description: The name of the dataset to export (e.g., 'user_segments', 'campaign_performance').

start_date.description: The start date for the data export, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: The end date for the data export, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

email_recipient.description: The email address to send the CSV file to.

include_header.description: Whether to include a header row in the CSV file.

function.name: get_conversion_rate
function.description: Calculates and retrieves the conversion rate for a specified goal over a given time frame. This helps in understanding the effectiveness of marketing efforts or user flows.

goal_name.description: The name of the conversion goal (e.g., 'purchase', 'signup', 'download').

start_date.description: The start date for the conversion rate calculation, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: The end date for the conversion rate calculation, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

segment_id.description: Optional: Filter the conversion rate by a specific user segment ID.
